title: All Divisions With the Highest Score of a Binary Array
goal: Find every split maximizing zeros on the left plus ones on the right.
strategy: Initially all ones belong to the right. Moving one element across the split adds a point for zero or removes a point for one, so every split can be scored incrementally.
